# E0351: a match is not exhaustive

A match is exhaustive: every value the source field can hold is matched by
an arm, or accepted by the target as it is, or caught by a `[_]` arm. Here one
value of an enum is none of these.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	kind: "a" | "b" | "c"
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	kind: "a" | "b"
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		kind: match(v0_0.kind, {
			"a": "b"
		})
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0351]: match on kind is not exhaustive: 0.0's kind may be "c", which no arm matches and 1.0's kind does not accept; add an arm for it, or a [_] arm
 --> 1.0.thema:8:9
  |
8 |         kind: match(v0_0.kind, {
  |               ^^^^^
  |
```
